english.note: Use 縮細 as the all-purpose verb for making something smaller or becoming smaller.
This is the all-purpose choice when something physically becomes smaller or is made smaller.
Use this specifically when what is being reduced is physical size, such as moving to a smaller home.

examples.english: Shrink the picture a little so it fits in the frame.
examples.traditional: 你將張相縮細少少，先至放得落個畫框。
examples.jyutping: nei5 zoeng1 zoeng1 soeng2 suk1 sai3 siu2 siu2 sin1 zi3 fong3 dak1 lok6 go3 waak6 kwaang1

examples.english: The shirt did diminish in size after washing.
examples.jyutping: gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 suk1 sai3 zo2

examples.english: We want to downsize our home and move to a smaller flat.
examples.traditional: 我哋想縮細屋企，搬去細啲嘅單位。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 suk1 sai3 uk1 kei5 bun1 heoi3 sai3 di1 ge3 daan1 wai2
